title: Erika Hakala (Oinas Marketing; ex-Onfido, Speechmatics, Productboard) — a founder's list of 6 governance moves from the Bookomi Soho House morning
summary: Erika Hakala — founder of Oinas Marketing, ex-Onfido/Speechmatics/Productboard — turns her Bookomi Books for Breakfast recap into a founder-actionable summary: six concrete moves to build the anti-corruption structure into a company from the outset (become a B Corp, set up as a cooperative, explore an industrial foundation structure, give employees meaningful ownership, put purpose into the corporate charter, define the mission so people know it). Cites the stat that industrial-foundation companies are 500% more likely to reach 50 years of trading.
blockquote: The bigger point for me is that you don't and shouldn't need to wait for the world to change. You can make these choices when you build the company. And why wouldn't you? Being ethical and being commercially successful don't have to be opposing goals.
